newsitem.title: UK: Northern Ireland manuf exports up 18 pct yr/yr. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Northern Ireland manuf exports up 18 pct yr/yr. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]

text.p: Manufacturing exports by Northern Ireland companies rose by 18 percent to 3.1 billion stg in the year to end-March 1996 (corrects from 1997), outstripping Britain's 14 percent increase overall, the Industrial Development Board for Northern Ireland said on Thursday.

"Manufacturing exports grew impressively over the year by 470 million...Local manufacturers now export 35 percent of their products, up from 33 percent last year and 28 percent in 1991/92," Northern Ireland economy minister Adam Ingram said in a statement.
The IDB said Northern Ireland's top export markets were the Republic of Ireland, the U.S., Germany and the Netherlands.
